task: Write useful customer-facing conversion copy grounded in the offer.
method: Lead with the buyer's job. Turn a documented attribute into a decision and end with one executable next step on the selected channel. Leave prices to the structured offer block.
applicability: Retail, service booking and trade quote pages

good.headline: Choose coverage for your floor plan
good.value_proposition: Plan a quote using the area of your project.
good.benefit: Compare the coverage per pack with the area you need.
good.call_to_action: Send your area and project location for a quote.

examples.bad: Increase campaign conversions by promising the lowest price.

rubric: One coherent headline, value proposition and fact-supported benefit.
A concrete buyer action suited to the permitted channel.
prohibited: Internal goals, invented offers, performance guarantees or seller instructions.

tests.expected: all structured output fields and applicable sources are present

release: Publish the reviewed workflow manifest containing this exact skill version and digest; activate only on the selected campaign.
rollback: Disable the candidate workflow for new runs and activate the previous compatible workflow. Retain pinned definitions and existing run receipts.
